name: minion
description: Give Claude its own Linux desktops: browser, office, dev, data and Windows apps that it reads as text and controls.
long_description:
Minion gives Claude its own computers: featherweight Linux desktops with Firefox, LibreOffice, a terminal, developer and data tools, or Windows programs (through Wine). Claude reads the screen as text, clicks and types, runs commands and Python, and copies files in and out. Watch any desktop live in your browser and take over with one click.

**You need Docker running:** Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Podman or Docker Engine. The first desktop of each kind downloads its image (199 to 717 MB). Python is not needed: Claude Desktop provides it through uv.

**Try:** *Create an office desktop, write a one-page brief about otters in Writer and save it as brief.docx in my Downloads.*

**Settings.** *Default desktop* is the profile Claude gets when it doesn't pick one. *Shared folder* is the only folder on your computer that Claude can copy files into a desktop from, or out of a desktop to.

Each desktop is an isolated container on your computer. Treat what Claude reads on a screen as untrusted (prompt injection), and keep passwords out of desktops: hand control to Claude only after you sign in yourself.

tools.name: desktop
tools.description: Create, list, fork, snapshot, freeze and remove desktops (browser, office, dev, research, data, windows, base).

tools.name: see
tools.description: Read the screen as text: windows and controls with stable @ids to click.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot, optionally with an @id drawn on every control.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Click, type, press keys, scroll and drag in one batch, then report what changed.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open an app, a website or a file and wait for its window.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a shell command inside a desktop.

tools.name: script
tools.description: Run Python inside a desktop to do many GUI steps in one call.

tools.name: files
tools.description: Copy files between the shared folder and a desktop, or read and write files in a desktop.

tools.name: view
tools.description: Open a live view in your browser, or hand control to you (to sign in, say) and wait.

default_profile.title: Default desktop
default_profile.description: The profile for a new desktop when Claude doesn't choose one: browser, office, dev, research, data, windows or base.

shared_folder.title: Shared folder
shared_folder.description: Claude can copy files into a desktop only from this folder (and its subfolders), and files it copies out of a desktop land here.
